battle_start.text: Enemies come from the troop the real-time host names. No barriers or wards: those are Second Gate systems this Project does not author.

round_start.text: A real-time round is ticksPerRound fixed scheduler ticks (ledger O1).

after_action.text: The instant a blow lands: boss phase changes hook here.

round_end.text: State ticks and skill timers keep round semantics. PE is each battler's own declared resource (system.battlerResources, ledger O3) and regenerates a little each round; the rate is a prototype value, not a verified original formula.

victory.text: Mutated rat rewards as reported by Day 1 guides: EXP 2, Ammo +6.

flee_attempt.text: Prototype: escape always succeeds, carried over from B009. The original's escape chance is unverified.
